# name: The grandmother laughs; the monkeys go to the forest; the field that clears itself
# title: Catepuch xe bixanic, xe zuanic
# fols: fols. 19r–20v
Catepuch xe bixanic, xe zuanic, xe cohomanic, ta vcamic ri qui zu, qui cohom; ta xcube puch ri catit cuꜭ. Ta xe zuanic, xe ziquix pa zu, pa bix, ta xu binaah ri Hunahpu Coy vbi zu.

Ta xe oc cu vloc ri Hunbaꜩ, Hunchouen, que xahouic ta xe vlic. Catepuch ta xmucun ri atit iꜩel qui vach, xril atit, ta xꜩeenic; maui xu cui vꜩe atit. Xa cu huzu xebec, maui xil chi qui vach.

“Eia, catit! Xebe pa quechelah. Naquipa chi bano, ix catit? Xa cahmul xchi ca tiho, xa oxmul chic. Xque ca ziquih pa zu, pa bix; qui chi cuyu iꜩe. Catiha china,” xeꜭha chic Hunahpu, Xbalanque.

Cate xe zuan chic; ta xe oc chi vloc, que xahou chic. Xe vl chic chi vnicahal vvaha. Xavi cu ꜫuz ca qui bano, xavi ca qui tacchih ri catit chi ꜩe; libahchi xꜩeen chiri catit. Quiꜩih ꜩeebal qui vach ri coy, chi xiri ri e xe qui pam, chi chitila he puch vchi qui ꜭux, ta xe oc vloc; are cut qui chu ꜩeeh atit.

Cate xebe chic pa tac huiub. “Naquipa xchi ca bano, ix catit? Xere chi va roxmul chic xchi ca tiho,” xꜭha ri Hunahpu, Xbalanque.

Xe zuan chic; xe vl chic que xahauic. Xa cu chu cuiu ca vꜩe ri catit. Xe acan cu vloc chu catanah ꜩac; caꜫruxruh vchi tac qui vach, muꜩumac qui chi, chi quimal qui chi, qui vach, macama chi qui hoꜫih chique. Ta xril chicut ri atit, cate xpocolih chi vꜩe ri catit. Ma chi cu xil chi qui vach rumal vꜩebal atit.

“Xere vi cua, ix catit, xque ca pixabah vbic chu cahmul cut.”

Xe zuax chic; macu xe vl chic chu cahmul; huzu xebec pa quechelah. Xeꜭha cut chire catit: “Mi cu xca tiho, ix catit; mi nabe xe vlic, mi pu xca tih chic qui ziquixic. Mi xbizon cut; oh ꜭolic, oh iviy, xa chilo coh ri ca chuch, ix catit. Que nabax ri caꜩ, ta chuxoc mi xe ꜭobic, mi pu xe binahic Hunbaꜩ, Hunchouen, que vꜭhaxic,” xeꜭha ri Hunahpu, Xbalanque.

Xe ziquix cut rumal ri ahzu, ahbix, ri oher vinac; are puch chu ziquih ri ahzib, ahcot oher. Xe chicopiric, e coy xe vxic, rumal xax qui nimarizah quib, xqui yoc ri qui chac.

Quehe vi calabil chi qui ꜭux, quehe cut qui maixic ri ta xe zachic ri Hunbaꜩ, Hunchouen, e chicop xe vxic. Are cut e ramaꜫelal co cochoch chic; xavi xere e ahzu, e ahbix nim chic xqui bano, ta xe coheic ruꜭ ratit, ruꜭ pu qui chuch.

Ta xqui tiquiba chicut qui banoh, qui cutbal quib chuvach catit, chuvach pu qui chuch. Nabe xqui bano ri abix. “Xa coh abixic, ix catit, ix pu ca chuch,” xeꜭha. “Mi xbizonic; oh ꜭolic, oh iviy, oh qui ꜫexel caꜩ,” xeꜭha cu ri Hunahpu, Xbalanque.

Ta xqui cam cut quicah, qui mixquina, qui xoquem; xebec ruꜭ huhun qui vvb xqui teleh. Xe el chi cochoch. Ta xqui pixab cu catit chire vyaic qui va: “Chi ticoh na ꜫih, chi be ya ca va, ix catit,” xeꜭha. “Vꜩ bala, ix viy,” xꜭha cut ri catit.

Catecut xe opon chiri que abix vi; xaqui xqui chiquiba ri mixquina pa vleu. Xa cu qui chi tahin ri mixquina pu vleu, ma cu qui chi tahin ri mixquina chutuquel.

Are curi icah xavi chi qui chiquiba chu toloc che, xavi chu cab rib che chi bec, chi lahahic chi bec ronohel che, caam; ꜫaꜫchacachoh chic chi catoh che chu ban ri xa huna icah.

Are curi mixquina ꜩaꜩ chi cupuh; maui ahilan tum quixic cu ban ri xa hun chi mixquina; maui ahilan cupuh xa chuti huyub, nima huyub ca hec.

Ta xqui pixabah cut hun chicop, Xmucur vbi; xqui tuyuba acan oc chuvi nima cutam. Xeꜭha cut Hunahpu, Xbalanque: “Xa chavil ri catit chi petic iaol ca va; huzu cat oꜫic ta petoc; catecut chi ca chap ri mixquina ruꜭ icah.” “Vꜩ bala,” xꜭha curi Xmucur.

Are cut xa vvbanic chi qui bano, mana quiꜩih abixic ta chi qui bano. Catepuch choc ri Xmucur; anim cut que petic, hun chi chapo mixquina, hun cut chi chapon ri icah.

Chi qui piz la qui vi; xaloc chu bacala vleu pu cab ri hun, xa quehe chu ꜩiloh vvach, queheri quiꜩih abixom. Are curi hunchic xaloc chu puquih vvebal che pu holom, quehe viri quiꜩih ꜫatoh cheenel.

Ta xil rumal catit. Catecut que vaic, ma quiꜩih abixic chi qui bano; xaloc chi be iaoc qui va. Ta xebe cut chi cochoch: “Quiꜩih mi xoh coꜩic, ix catit,” queꜭha, que oponic. Xaloc chi qui quiquih chi qui yuc puch cacan, qui ꜫab chuvach catit.

Ta xebe chicut chu caꜫih; xe opon cut pa cabix. Quiz iacatahinac chic ronohel che, caam; vchapom chi rib ronohel tum, quixic, ta xe oponic. “Apachinac coh michouic?” xeꜭha cut. Are cut que banou ri ronohel chuti chicop, nima chicop: coh, balam, queh, vmul, iac, vtiu, aꜫ, ziz, chuti ꜯiquin, nima ꜯiquin; are xe banouic. Xa hun acab xqui bano.
